Retrieves the list of SSL/TLS certificates used by an asset based on the specified asset ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1/organizations/:orgId/assets/:assetId/certificates

Retrieves the list of SSL/TLS certificates used by an asset based on the specified asset ID. To learn more, see Understanding Asset Details.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
orgId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

assetId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

HEADER PARAMETERS
Authorization
string
REQUIRED

API authentication token

Default value: Bearer your-token

OK
